primary_claim: Training a 12M-parameter transformer LM on TinyStories with the Adam optimizer produces privileged-basis outlier channels (excess kurtosis exceeding 100), while training the identical model with SGD produces no privileged basis (excess kurtosis near 0), conclusively showing Adam causes the outlier-channel phenomenon.

effect.metric: excess kurtosis of residual stream activations

stated_future_work: Use sparse autoencoders to see if learned features align with the outlier channels
What are the exact mechanics within Adam that cause features to align with basis dimensions?
quote: While the Adam-trained model's excess kurtosis quickly exceeds 100, the excess kurtosis of the SGD trained model remains approximately 0 throughout training.
